svg.title: What an agent session costs
svg.desc: Line chart of median session cost by app, model and turn range, on a log scale; the spread at the longest published turn range is the finding.
svg.text: At the longest published session, the model you pick changes the cost by up to 258×
median USD per session · log scale · trailing 30-day window to 2026-10-18 · each line is one model in one app
vertical distance at the right edge is the whole argument; apps publish different turn ranges, so compare within a panel
In Codex at 50+ turns, a session costs $0.0651 on muse-spark-1.3-contributor and $16.78 on gpt-6-astra — a 258× spread.
Median session cost at list price, for the models each app actually serves. Not a benchmark of the models and not a claim about quality.

Orange marks a Chinese lab; the grouping is by lab headquarters, not by where the inference runs. Claude Code publishes only to 10–49 turns; Hermes Agent publishes only to 2–9 turns, so those spreads cover a shorter session.
Source: OpenRouter Data API, as of 2026-10-18. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
